feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 18 November 2026 10:35pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Variable amounts of cloud at first tonight then with cloud becoming more widespread. Scattered showers at first clearing the area for a time overnight, then with the risk of some patchy rain later in the night, particularly in the south of the island. Light to moderate easterly winds overnight, minimum temperatures of 4°C in some places at first then recovering during the night.

Cloudy with patchy outbreaks of rain developing early in the morning clearing to become largely dry in the afternoon, but remaining cloudy until later in the evening. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, locally strong in northern parts at first, with temperatures up to 9°C.

Comments: Strong wind at first.


##Outlook##

A chilly start to the day with minimum of around 2°C, but otherwise dry and mainly sunny during the daytime, a moderate northeast breeze falling light, and temperatures up to 9°C.

Comments: Risk of frost in sheltered places.

7:53am Tomorrow

4:13pm Tomorrow
